title: dunalia breviflora var. glabrata
intro: Dunalia breviflora var. glabrata, commonly known as the "Peruvian Pebble Flower", is a plant species that belongs to the family Phytolaccaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, as well as its potential to help manage anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Dunalia breviflora var. glabrata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties. Additionally, this plant is reported to have anti-anxiety and sedative effects, making it a potential natural remedy for promoting relaxation and sleep quality.
